rows.grounds: compound locative indicating locus of binding

items.question: By what count and in what locus are certain beings held in a state of torment according to this claim?
premises: A count of eighty-four is specified here.
That count falls within thousands as a locus set.
The locus is identified as womb-diagrams.
Beings in that locus are said to be tormented.
items.inference: Beings are tormented in eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
uncertainties: Whether the count is exhaustive or exemplary remains unclear.
items.plain_english: In eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams, beings are tormented.
